title: AUTH-076 access expiry boundary

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; refresh R expires at T+13524 seconds
4. When the controlled browser clock reaches T+900 seconds
5. Then the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
6. And exactly one dialog named "Your session has been expired" is visible on the Home page
7. And the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired" is visible
8. And the button labelled "Logout" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired" is visible
9. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"

annotations.description: Actual MFE; Playwright clock; controlled API responses; unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle or BFF expiry claim.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
